answer: A durable anti-sybil rule: each identity must grow a juniper of locked stake that only unlocks after sustained graded work. Soft coordination leaves a whisper of correlated timing and graph edges; the protocol treats that whisper as a vine linking clones and raises bond cost on every new node in the vine. Attackers pay compounding capital for each fake while emission stays gated behind non-transferable attested answers, so mass identities become cash-negative before they mature.
